canonical_project: Viettel Tan Phu Trung (TPTIP) Data Center
notes: Groundbreaking ~24 Apr 2025 at Tan Phu Trung Industrial Park, Cu Chi district; Vietnam's first >100 MW hyperscale data center: up to 140 MW, about 10,000 racks, ~40,000 sqm on a 4 ha site, Uptime Tier III, target PUE <1.4; Phase 1 expected operational by Q1 2026, full build-out before 2030.
